title: Smiling Young Man by Window Outside, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny, candid black-and-white outdoor portrait of a young person wearing a light-colored short-sleeved shirt, leaning casually with one arm resting on a stone railing or ledge. Behind them is a multi-paned glass window, a louvered shutter or vent, and hanging tree leaves framing the upper corner. The reverse side features a single stamped processing number '262'.
